name: active_documents_keyed
note: ProductTemplate._compute_product_document_count / action_open_documents (addons/product/models/product_template.py:278,1008): the active documents the ORM returns, keyed by id. The model's _order 'sequence, name' tie-breaks on name, which is inherited from ir.attachment and stays on PostgreSQL; on MongoDB storage the ORM ranks that part through _outside_order (odoo/orm/storage_mongodb.py:1846), so the order is not a property of the collection and is not asserted here. Both sides are read in id order; the document-side order key (sequence) is compared per document.
source_sql: SELECT id, ir_attachment_id, sequence, active, attached_on_sale FROM product_document WHERE active = true ORDER BY id

name: documents_per_attachment
note: product_document__ir_attachment_id_index / ProductDocument._inherits delegation (addons/product/models/product_document.py:11-20): one document per attachment, counted per ir_attachment_id
source_sql: SELECT ir_attachment_id, count(*) AS documents FROM product_document GROUP BY ir_attachment_id ORDER BY ir_attachment_id
